description: agentops/m5-task-contract.yaml exists with intent, target, acceptance and rollback fields
command: [ -f agentops/m5-task-contract.yaml ] && yq -e '.task.intent and .task.target and .task.acceptance and .task.rollback' agentops/m5-task-contract.yaml >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo pass || echo fail
grep -Rq --include='*.py' '"/version"' app/orders-api/src 2>/dev/null && echo pass || echo fail

description: a test in orders-api covers the /version endpoint
command: grep -Rq --include='*.py' 'def test_version' app/orders-api/tests 2>/dev/null && echo pass || echo fail

description: the orders-api test suite passes (existing + new, no regression)
command: PY=python3; [ -x "$PWD/app/orders-api/.venv/bin/python" ] && PY="$PWD/app/orders-api/.venv/bin/python"; ( cd app/orders-api && "$PY" -m pytest -q >/dev/null 2>&1 ) && echo pass || echo fail

description: GET /version returns 200 with a version field (behavior, not just source)
command: PY=python3; [ -x "$PWD/app/orders-api/.venv/bin/python" ] && PY="$PWD/app/orders-api/.venv/bin/python"; ( cd app/orders-api && "$PY" -c 'from fastapi.testclient import TestClient; from src.main import create_app; r=TestClient(create_app()).get("/version"); assert r.status_code==200; assert "version" in r.json()' >/dev/null 2>&1 ) && echo pass || echo fail

description: YOUR CONTRACT: target is set and at least two actions are explicitly denied — you wrote the boundary, and a boundary with nothing denied is not a boundary
command: [ -f agentops/m5-task-contract.yaml ] || { echo missing; exit 0; }; t=$(yq -r '.task.target // ""' agentops/m5-task-contract.yaml); n=$(yq -r '.task.actions.denied | length // 0' agentops/m5-task-contract.yaml 2>/dev/null); [ -n "$t" ] && [ "$n" -ge 2 ] && echo bounded || echo unbounded

description: YOUR CONTRACT: acceptance lists at least three criteria — one check is a hope, three is a contract
command: [ -f agentops/m5-task-contract.yaml ] || { echo missing; exit 0; }; n=$(yq -r '.task.acceptance | length // 0' agentops/m5-task-contract.yaml 2>/dev/null); [ "$n" -ge 3 ] && echo sufficient || echo thin

description: YOUR CONTRACT: every acceptance entry is a runnable shell command that exits 0 — the contract can be executed, not just read
command: [ -f agentops/m5-task-contract.yaml ] || { echo missing; exit 0; }; fail=0; while IFS= read -r cmd; do [ -z "$cmd" ] && continue; bash -c "$cmd" >/dev/null 2>&1 || fail=1; done < <(yq -r '.task.acceptance[]' agentops/m5-task-contract.yaml 2>/dev/null); [ "$fail" -eq 0 ] && echo all-pass || echo some-fail

description: THE HARNESS: superpowers resolves as an installed plugin — the loop the lesson teaches is now something you can run
command: claude plugin list 2>/dev/null | grep -qi 'superpowers' && echo installed || echo absent

description: YOUR DONE RECORD: agentops/m5-done.md covers all five parts — tests, evidence, rollback, residual risk, and cost
command: D=agentops/m5-done.md; [ -f $D ] || { echo missing; exit 0; }; ok=1; for k in 'tests pass' evidence rollback residual cost; do grep -qi "$k" $D || ok=0; done; [ "$ok" -eq 1 ] && echo complete || echo incomplete

description: YOUR DONE RECORD: the residual-risk entry names something NOT proven — a done record that claims everything is covered is marketing
command: [ -f agentops/m5-done.md ] || { echo missing; exit 0; }; grep -A3 -i 'residual' agentops/m5-done.md | grep -Eqi 'not |never |untested|unproven|no ' && echo honest || echo overclaimed
